scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && node -e "const fs=require('node:fs');const path=require('node:path');const distPath=path.join(process.cwd(),'dist');const backendPath=path.join(distPath,'backend');const runtimePath=path.join(distPath,'runtime');if(fs.existsSync(runtimePath)){fs.rmSync(runtimePath,{recursive:true,force:true});}if(fs.existsSync(backendPath)){fs.renameSync(backendPath,runtimePath);}const entryPath=path.join(distPath,'main.js');const launcher='\"use strict\";require(\"./runtime/src/main.js\");\n';fs.writeFileSync(entryPath,launcher,'utf-8');"
